purpose: Superseded before generation. This V28 brief proposed subtle iconic ornaments after V27 owner-art review failed, but the owner then required much larger state-specific visual changes that make charging and recording unmistakable at a glance. No V28 source image was generated or may be inferred from this request.
identity_invariants: retain the locked V9 open oval eye silhouette, black fill, one large white oval highlight and one small white diamond sparkle per eye
retain the locked V9 eye-pair scale, spacing, baseline, nose anchor and monochrome ink weight
do not introduce a new eye shape, iris, pupil, eyelash, colour, face outline, ear, whisker or whole-face card
all brows, mouth, cheeks, highlights and ornaments are clean separately extractable components inside a 200x200 safe face area
use no literal menu, microphone, battery, plug, lightning, waveform, cursor, punctuation, text, heart, star or emoji
ornaments must attach visually to the face/head pose and cannot be a detached generic status widget
ornaments reinforce a face-primary functional read and never carry all of the meaning alone

previous_read_failures_not_to_repeat.menu_active: must not read as generic neutral, worry, uncertainty, anger or generic confusion
previous_read_failures_not_to_repeat.recording_active: must not read as concern, surprise, alarm or broadcast
previous_read_failures_not_to_repeat.charging_active: must not read as generic excitement, sleep, Daily or ordinary happiness
previous_read_failures_not_to_repeat.all_states: must not lack a memorable state-specific character ornament

panel_contract: Generate one unbordered, unlabeled left-to-right row of exactly three same-scale faces: menu_active, recording_active, charging_active. Each face has a clear face-primary brow-mouth-cheek-highlight action plus exactly one memorable state-specific ornament. The ornament must be visibly anchored to the brows, outer-eye area or forehead as a character accessory and must be independently extractable. The panel is source provenance only; later runtime may export only registered components and must perform each action and ornament through a deterministic component sequence.

poses.static_read: purposeful choosing with a recognizable navigator accessory
poses.facial_action: Use a low composed brow pair with one restrained decision lift, shared same-side legal highlight bias, a compact closed decision mouth and steady cheeks. It must read focused and friendly rather than worried or generic neutral.
poses.iconic_ornament: A small asymmetric navigator ribbon-pin anchored directly above the right brow. It has two compact rounded tabs and one tiny central knot, like a mascot navigation hair ornament, never an arrow, cursor, menu glyph, crown or floating mark. It belongs to the brow line and is clearly separable.
poses.later_choreography: the ribbon-pin gives one tiny settle as highlights scan left-to-center-to-right and the decision face lands

poses.static_read: active listening with recognizable listener ornaments
poses.facial_action: Use low receptive brows with soft outer ends, centered attentive legal highlights, a small closed acknowledgement mouth and calm open cheeks. It must read listening, never concern, surprise, alarm or broadcast.
poses.iconic_ornament: A matched pair of rounded listener ear-cuffs hugging the outer eye-cheek edges, visually attached to the face rather than floating. Each is a single compact decorative cuff with one inner notch, never a microphone, headphone pictogram, waveform or repeated sound wave. They are clean separate components.
poses.later_choreography: the two listener cuffs make one restrained outward acknowledgement pulse after attention arrives, then hold still

poses.static_read: settled replenishment with a recognizable renewal ornament
poses.facial_action: Use low soft brows released outward, lower settled legal highlights, a broad but compact closed recovery smile and visibly softened lifted cheeks. It must read restorative relief, never ordinary happy excitement, sleep or Daily.
poses.iconic_ornament: A single small three-petal renewal bud anchored at the forehead just above the brows, like a mascot energy-blossom accessory. It is an organic rounded ornament, never a lightning bolt, battery, plug, halo, sparkle, heart or floating status icon. It is cleanly separable.
poses.later_choreography: the renewal bud gently opens one step as the face releases into recovery, then settles and reverses exactly

machine_preconditions_before_owner_revie: source gate proves locked-V9-only lineage, identity invariants, no literal UI symbols, exactly one state-specific ornament per pose and pairwise face-primary separation
component export retains exact locked V9 identity components and source-derived brows/mouth/cheeks/ornaments only
browser and target PBM replay the same deterministic component plan at native 200x200
internal visual preflight evaluates unlabeled target holds plus causal playback and rejects every wrong, generic or unornamented reading before an operator prompt
